title: New Blood
subtitle: The new blood will rush into the gigantic body, making every effort to serve it.

items.text: New Blood

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ma-Matilda ...? It's you?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I'm sorry! I-I ... thought it was someone suspicious, so ...
Matilda buries her face in her palms and shrugs her shoulders.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Matilda ... Are you alright?
Matilda gives Sonetto a push and steps back. Her face blushes.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Sonetto! How dare you!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Attacked the monitor student in Primary Defense, and disturbed the peace in public, YOU!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: As your classmate used-to-be, I'm obliged to stop you from making a scene here and disturbing the patients!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I'm, I'm here to give you my warning ...
She suddenly runs towards the other end of the hallway before Sonetto can possibly react to it and do something.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Please wait ...!
Bump ...!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ouch!

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Oh, isn't it the "Sonneteer"? And ... our outstanding graduate.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: I thought it was some acute mania patient getting out, waiting for my fancy transcranial magnetic stimulation therapy.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Err ... it hurts.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Wh-what! Sonneteer?! How would I have anything to do with her ...?!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I'm Matilda Bouanich, the Top 3 student in school, the monitor assistant, and the speaker of graceful French!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: None shall forget my name after making the acquaintance of me!

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: I didn't, but I guess no one will remember the third place.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Wha-

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Go away, go! Don't stand in my way!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Matilda! Please take ...
Matilda runs away without looking back. Sonetto stands there, with a handkerchief in her hand. She is about to give it to Matilda.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: She just ran away like that? There is even garbage dust on her hair.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I didn't know she was the one following me. I shouldn't have acted in haste ...

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Alright, get down to business.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Sonetto, you are here visiting the timekeeper, right?

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Follow me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Okay.
Joint Committee of SF
A little bird told me you went to visit Vertin, is that right?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes.
How was she doing?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Just like the other patients.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Unconscious.
Artificial Somnambulism Therapy shall be good for her.
It's been four years since she became the Timekeeper. She surely needs a break.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes, and I have no other opinion about this, Madam Vice President.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I'm here for another issue.
Madam Z places a stack of files on the desk.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The proposal of additional manpower submitted by the House of Integratus ... I have given it consideration. It's not worth a committee hearing.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Are you here to talk about dead plans?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes, because I have the exact opposite view.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Vertin's suitcase will not be affected by the "Storm," just like the buildings in our headquarters.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Which means she will soon be able to form a team ... indirectly controlled by the Foundation.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I suggest putting her in command of an independent autonomous unit. With enough support, they should soon become another reliable force of the Foundation.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: And it also facilitates our relationship with Vertin.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The people Vertin brought back with her, who are they?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Arcanists who have stable personalities, good command over their arcane skills, and some social experiences.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: If you ask me, they are some pitiful exiles who lost everything in the "Storm."

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: So desperate, horrified, and overwhelmed, longing for something stable to hold on to.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Vertin is not here. Only the Foundation can give them what they want.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: But what can they give us in return?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The innate arbitrariness of arcanists? Or questioning our beliefs of mankind supremacy because they have nobler blood?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Of course, the Foundation needs new blood. Especially those ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: who are highly obedient and know the importance of order.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: That's why these poor refugees need no independent unit or autonomy.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: They need the guidance of disciplines, a teaching more comprehensive than what's been given to those naive children in school.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: What you want is a group of dumb puppets.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I'm always the optimist in the room, and you know that, Ms. Z.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: This won't so much be a dead plan if one day they can prove they are not some dumb puppets.
TO BE CONTINUED…
